name: Honeycomb Smoke
source:
Lying low in a dangerous city, you receive a cryptic message from an old friend. Could your luck have changed, or has the past finally caught up with you?

[from [url=https://justababy-studio.itch.io/honeycomb-smoke]itch.io[/url]]
